description: Search the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" knowledge base (/tmp/churn-sk0dg17w/heldfast-churn-placeholder) for cited passages. Returns compact citations by default; send related questions together in queries (up to 5) to share one budget. Passages already returned in this session come back as short seen stubs. Each result has a citation (path, lines or page, chunk), an excerpt, and weakEvidence when support is thin; an empty result means the base holds no evidence, so say so instead of guessing. Expand one citation, or set compact:false, only when full text is needed.

compact.description: Default true: citations with short excerpts. false returns full passage text.

contextPaths.description: Limit hits to these heading paths, such as "Guide > Migration".

contextRadius.description: Neighbouring chunks added on each side of a hit, 0 to 3.

excludePaths.description: Skip files under these project-relative paths or globs.

explain.description: Adds the retrieval query and ranking signals; signals, not confidence.

includePaths.description: Search only files under these project-relative paths or globs.

maxBytes.description: Output budget in bytes for this call; the server caps it at its configured maximum.

maxChunksPerDocument.description: Most passages returned from one file. Default 1.

queries.description: Instead of query: up to 5 related questions answered together in one output budget.

query.description: One question, in natural language or with exact identifiers.

scope.description: A named source scope from the config; ragmir_status lists them.

seen.description: Passages already returned in this session: collapse (default) to short stubs, include them in full again, or exclude them.

topK.description: Passages per question. Default 3; the server caps it.

name: ragmir_search
title: Ragmir search: heldfast-churn-placeholder
